segments.source: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
segments.reference: Paul, Isor laga ekjon noukar, Jisu Khrista laga apostle, aru Isor pora basi luwa khan laga biswas nimite aru hosa gyaan thaka juntu ki bhal ase etu logote ekta ase,
segments.hypothesis: Paul, Isor laga noukar aru Jisu Khrista laga ekjon apostle, Isor pora basi luwa manu khan laga biswas aru Isor laga biswas, juntu Isor laga hosa ase, etu nisena,

segments.source: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
segments.reference: anonto jibon te asha rakhi thaka, juntu Isor, kun kitia bhi misa nokoi, yug shuru nakora age pora kosom rakhidise.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nimite anonto jibon laga asha te, Isor, kun pora misa kotha kobole para nai, aru Tai laga kosom to pura kori bole nimite kosom dise.

segments.source: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
segments.reference: Aru thik homoi te, Tai laga kotha prokahit kori dise, amikhan laga Tran-Korta Isor laga hukum pora moike kori bole hukum dise.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu Tai laga kotha to moi Isor laga Tran-Korta laga hukum nisena dikhai dise,

segments.source: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
segments.reference: Titus ke, amikhan laga biswas te thaka ekjon asol chokra; amikhan laga Baba Isor, Tran-Korta Jisu Khrista te anugrah aru shanti hoi thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Titus, ekjon bhal bacha, biswas, ekjon pura-pura, Isor aru shanti aru shanti, amikhan laga Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista amikhan laga Tran-Korta Jisu Khrista laga Transoh pora.

segments.source: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
segments.reference: Moi etu karone tumike Crete majuli te chari jaise, ki kaam thik nohoi kene thakise eitu khan thik kori bole, aru moi tumike kowa nisena, sheher te girja laga rokhiya kori bole bura khan ke basi lobi.
segments.hypothesis: Aru moi apnikhan ke Crete te chari dise, etu nimite apnikhan sob laga kotha te mon dangor hoi kene, aru moi apnikhan nimite cholawta khan ke basi loise, jineka apnikhan ke moi laga niyom dise.

segments.source: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
segments.reference: Aru bura khan to golti nathaka hobo lage, aru ekjon maiki laga mota hobo lage, aru tai laga bacha khan bhi adat biya aru kotha namana eneka nohobo lage.
segments.hypothesis: Jodi kunba ekjon maiki laga mota to eku bhi eku nai, tai laga bacha khan ase, aru biswas kora bacha khan logote biya kaam kora nohoi, aru taikhan ke golti nakore.

segments.source: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
segments.reference: Kelemane ekjon girja laga cholawta to Isor laga ghor sa karone eku napuncha nathakibo lage. Aru tai ekjon nijor khushi te jai thaka, aru joldi khong kora, aru misa kotha, aru jhagara kora, aru lalchi nohobo lage.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane etu pora bhi eku bhi eku bodnam nathakibo lage, jineka Isor laga kaam hisab te thik pora nohoi, aru tai laga khong to biya nohoi, kintu etu to biya kaam nimite nohoi, etu nimite biya kaam kora nohoi.

segments.source: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
segments.reference: Kintu tai alohi manu ke tai laga ghor te rakhibo para hobo lage, dhorjo kora, sidha mon thaka, pobitro thaka, nijorke rukhabole para hobo lage.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu bhal kaam nimite, bhal kaam kori bole nimite, aru bhal, pobitro, pobitro aru bhal kaam,

segments.source: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
segments.reference: Tai hosa biswas kotha ke thik dhori thaka, aru manu ke Isor laga kotha to bhal pora bujhai dibo para, kotha namana khan ke thik rasta dikha bo para hobo lage.
segments.hypothesis: Sob hosa kotha khan ke mani kene thakibi, Tai hikai diya kotha hisab te, Tai awaj te hikai dibo aru kun manu Taike bodnam kori bole paribo, taikhan ke bujhai dibo.

segments.source: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
segments.reference: Kelemane, bisi Yehudi biswasi manu khan ase, kunkhan kotha bhi namane, aru sunnot laga kotha te eku motlob nathaka kotha koi aru dusra ke thogai thake.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile kunba manu khan bhi misa-misi kotha kora manu ase, aru thogai diya manu khan ase, kintu sunnot kora khan nimite bhi bisi manu ase.

segments.source: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
segments.reference: Eitu khan ke rukhai dibole dorkar ase. Taikhan sorom kamai lobo nimite ghor-ghor ke sikhai thake.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan laga mukh to mati kene rakhibo lage, aru jun manu sob ghor khotom kori dibo, taikhan ki lage etu sikhai, taikhan ke eku labh nathaka karone sikhai dibo.

segments.source: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
segments.reference: Taikhan majot te ekjon bhabobadi asele kun pora koi rakhise, “Creta laga manu to sob misa koi thake, aru dusto janwar aru alsi kha-kuwa khan ase.”
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan majote ekjon bhabobadi taikhan laga majote kotha koi thakise, "Baja manu khan hodai misa koi ase, aru eku bhi misa-misi aru biya janwar laga kotha koi thake."

segments.source: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
segments.reference: Etu gawahi hosa ase, karone taikhan ke kara pora koi thakibi, taikhan biswas te thik thaki bole nimite,
segments.hypothesis: Etu laga gawahi to hosa ase. Etu nimite, taikhan ke bhal pora bhal pora dhorjo kori kene dhorjo te bhal pora huni bhi,

segments.source: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
segments.reference: aru taikhan ke Yehudi laga kotha khisa khan aru hosa ke namani kene ghuri juwa khan laga piche jabo nadibi.
segments.hypothesis: Yehudi khan laga niyom khan aru Yehudi khan pora mani kene mani kene thakibi, aru jun hosa pora ulai, taikhan laga niyom to kitia bhi kitia bhi nabhabi.

segments.source: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
segments.reference: Mon sapha thaka khan nimite hoile sob bostu to sapha ase, kintu sapha nathaka aru biswas nakora khan nimite hoile eku bhi sapha nai, kintu taikhan laga dimag aru bhabona te bhi sob letera ase.
segments.hypothesis: sapha sapha kori bole nimite, sapha thaka sob to sapha ase, kintu jun khan ke letera aru abiswasi aru abiswasi khan laga eku bhi sapha nohoi, kintu taikhan laga bhabona to sapha nohoi.

segments.source: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
segments.reference: Taikhan Isor ke jane koi, kintu kaam te hoile taike namane. Taikhan ke to ghin kori bole lage aru taikhan kotha namana khan ase aru eku bhal kaam kori bole thik nohoi.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan Isor ke jane, kintu taikhan laga kaam pora he Taike namanibo, aru taikhan laga biya kaam khan aru kotha namani kene, aru kotha namane, aru kun nimite bhi bhal kaam nimite eku kaam nai.

segments.source: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
segments.reference: Kintu tumi to hoile, ki kotha koi, etu hosa hisab te sikhai di thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu, juntu kotha khan bhal pora sikhai ase, etu koi dibi.

segments.source: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
segments.reference: Bura manu khan ke gusa nauthi bole, bhal bhabona kori bole, nijorke nomro kori bole, biswas te thaki bole, morom kori bole, aru dhorjo pora thaki bole sikhai dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu poila manu khan mon dangor hoi kene thakibo lage, bhal, bhal hoi jabo, mon dangor kori kene, biswas, aru biswas te, morom, aru dhorjo kori bole,

segments.source: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
segments.reference: Etu nisena dangor umor thaka mahila khan ke bhi pobitro jibon laga bhal niyom thakibo nimite sikhabi, misa kotha kowa aru draikha ros piya nohobo lage, etu bodli, ki bhal ase etu dusra khan ke hikai thaki bole sikhai dibi.
segments.hypothesis: aru dangor mahila khan bhi kaam kori kene thakibo lage, biya kaam kora khan nohoi, biya manu khan ke, aru biya kaam kori bole nimite sikhai diya khan ke bhal kaam kori dibo,

segments.source: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
segments.reference: Etu nisena jawan mahila khan ke tai laga mota aru bacha ke kineka morom koribo lage, etu sikhai dibi,
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan bacha khan ke taikhan laga mota ke morom kori bole nimite sikhai dibo, aru taikhan laga bacha khan nisena morom koribo.

segments.source: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
segments.reference: bhal bhabona thaka, sapha mon thaka, nijor mota laga kotha mani thaka, sapha hoi nijor ghor kaam te bhal thaka mahila khan hobole sikhai dibi, tinehoile Isor laga pobitro kotha ke hinsa nohobo.
segments.hypothesis: Aru manu khan mon dangor hoi kene ghor te kaam kora khan, nijor mota laga kotha mani kene Isor laga kotha ke bodnam kori bole nimite koise.

segments.source: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
segments.reference: Aru etu nisena jawan manu ke bhal kaam kori bole samjai dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nisena, bacha khan ke mon dangor koribi.

segments.source: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
segments.reference: Tumi laga sob kaam te bhal namuna he dikhai dibi. Aru tumi ki sikhai ase etu hosa aru sapha pora kowa kotha hobo lage,
segments.hypothesis: Apuni khan laga kotha khan to bhal kaam khan dikhai dibi, apuni khan laga sikhai diya to hosa ase, aru hosa kaam khan ke dikhai dibi.

segments.source: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
segments.reference: juntu hosa kotha ase aru junke eku golti dibo na paribo, eneka hoile kun tumike digdar diye, taikhan sorom hobo, ki karone taikhan pora amikhan laga eku bhi biya kobo na paribo.
segments.hypothesis: aru kotha pora kotha kora to apuni khan ke bodnam kori bole napare, jun apuni laga kotha koi ase, apuni khan laga biya kotha koi kene sorom hobo, aru amikhan nimite eku biya kotha nai.

segments.source: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
segments.reference: Sewak khan ke sob kaam te malik laga kotha mani thaki bole sikhai dibi, khushi pora aru eku jhagara nakori kene,
segments.hypothesis: Aru noukar khan nijor laga malik khan logote thik pora mani kene thaki bole nimite, aru sob kotha te thik nohoi, etu laga motlob to kotha ase,

segments.source: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
segments.reference: nijor malik laga eku chor nakori kene aru sob bhal kaam to biswas pora dikhai dibole nimite sikhai dibi, eneka korile bhal naam to amikhan laga Tran-korta Isor pora sikhai diya kotha ke pabo.
segments.hypothesis: Bhowas, kintu sob bhal kaam khan ke dikhai nadibi, titia taikhan Isor laga Tran-Korta ke sikhai diya to amikhan laga Transolog te sob kaam kori bole nimite.

segments.source: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
segments.reference: Kelemane Isor pora aha anugrah to sob manu laga poritran nimite ase.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane Isor laga anugrah to ahise, sob manu khan nimite poritran anise.

segments.source: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
segments.reference: Etu amikhan ke sikhai ase, etu pora he, ki biya ase aru duniya laga itcha hisab te ase etu ke amikhan nabhabibo, aru nijorke rukhabole paribo, dharmik thakibo paribo, eneka hoile etu yug te Isor ke jana jibon thaki bole paribo,
segments.hypothesis: Etu yug laga itcha khan ke bujhai dibi, amikhan ke eku motlob nai, aru prithibi laga itcha ke chari kene chari kene thaka, amikhan jinda thakibo, aru etu yug te Isor laga dharmikta thakibo.

segments.source: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
segments.reference: kele koile amikhan etu asis laga din nimite rukhi ase jitia sob pora dangor Isor aru Tran-korta Jisu Khrista arubi wapas ahibo.
segments.hypothesis: Isor aru Tran-Korta ke dhanyavad dikena asha bisari thake, Jisu Khrista,

segments.source: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
segments.reference: Jisu he amikhan ke niyom namana paap pora udhar koribo nimite nijor jibon daan dise, aru Tai nijor nimite pobitro kori kene ekta jati bonai loise, kunkhan bhal kaam kori bole khushi kore.
segments.hypothesis: Tai amikhan ke Tai laga itcha dise, Tai sob paap pora amikhan ke bachai dibole aru sob paap laga manu khan nimite, Tai nijor laga nijor kaam nimite, bhal kaam nimite amikhan nimite.

segments.source: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
segments.reference: Girja te etu kotha khan sikai dibi, aru manu sobke eitu khan kori bole mon dangor kori dibi, aru adhikar thaka hisab te golti kora khan ke sidha kori bhi. Kun pora bhi apuni ke hisab nathaka hobo nadibi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu kotha khan ke huni bhi aru mon dangor koribi, aru sob adhikar pora bujhai dibi, aru kun bhi tumike chinta nakoribo.

segments.source: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
segments.reference: Girja te aha khan ke janai dibi cholawta aru dangor khan laga niche thaki bole, taikhan laga kotha mani bole, aru hodai bhal kaam nimite taiyar thaki bole,
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan ke cholawta aru adhikari khan logote mani kene thaki bole nimite hukum chola bhi aru adhikari laga kotha mani kene thakibi, aru sob bhal kaam nimite taiyar kori bole nimite taiyar koribi.

segments.source: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
segments.reference: kunke bhi bodnam nakoribole aru jhagara nakoribole, kintu sob logote nomro aru bhal niyom pora thaki bole.
segments.hypothesis: Kun manu bhi eku biya kotha na koribi, etu nimite mon dangor thakibi, nomro hoi kene, nomro hobole nimite, nomro thakibi, aru nomro hoi jabole nimite, aru sob manu khan ke mon dangor koribi.

segments.source: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
segments.reference: Kilekoile amikhan bhi ekta somoite eku bhabona nathaka aru kotha namana thakise. Amikhan mangso laga itcha pora dhori kene harai ja khan thakise. Amikhan paap kori thakise aru dusra ke suku joli thakise. Amikhan bisi ghin thakise aru ekjon- ekjon ke bhi ghin kori thakisele.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile amikhan bhi murkho thakise, aru kotha namana khan, aru alag-alag bhabona kori kene, aru biya kaam kori kene khushi aru mon dangor kori kene aru biya pora mon dangor hoi kene, biya kaam kora, aru ekjon-ekjon ke biya kaam korise.

segments.source: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
segments.reference: Hoile bhi jitia Udhar-korta Isor laga morom manu uporte dikhai dise,
segments.hypothesis: Kintu jitia amikhan laga Tran-Korta laga morom aru manu khan ke morom kore,

segments.source: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
segments.reference: juntu amikhan laga kaam aru dharmikta pora nohoi, kintu Tai laga anugrah pora poritran anidise, aru Pobitro Atma dwara notun jonom aru notun jibon dise,
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan nijorke dharmik kaam kora nohoi, kintu Tai laga daya hisab te, Tai amikhan ke bachai dise, aru Pobitro Atma laga modot pora amikhan ke notun kori dise.

segments.source: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
segments.reference: amikhan laga Udhar-korta Jisu Khrista karone Pobitro Atma amikhan ke bhorta haali dise,
segments.hypothesis: Jisu Khrista dwara amikhan ke Isor laga Tran-Korta pora bisi dhuni dise.

segments.source: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
segments.reference: etu nimite Tai laga anugrah karone amikhan ke dhormik bonai kene anonto jibon laga asha te Tai laga uttoradhikari bonai dibo karone.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nimite amikhan Isor laga anugraha pora dharmik hobole nimite basi lobo, etu pora amikhan ke anonto jibon laga asha nisena bonai dibo.

segments.source: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
segments.reference: Etu kotha to biswas koribo laga ase. Aru tumikhan ke etu kotha taikhan ke jor pora koi dibole mon ase, etu pora kunkhan Isor ke biswas korise, taikhan bhal kaam te mon dikene kori thakibo nimite. Etu kotha to bhal aru sob karone labh ase.
segments.hypothesis: Etu kotha to hosa ase, aru etu kotha khan nimite moi mon dangor pora koi ase, etu nimite jun Isor ke biswas kore taikhan ke biswas kori bole nimite mon dangor kori dibo. Etu kaam khan to manu khan nimite bhal kaam ase.

segments.source: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
segments.reference: Kintu misa-misi kotha koi thaka, aru khandan khan khisa, aru jhagara kora, aru niyom laga kotha nimite jhagara kora sob to chari di bhi kele koile eitu khan eku labh nai.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu murkho kotha khan, manu khan, biya kaam kori bole, aru biya kaam khan, aru niyom laga kotha khan kotha khan ke kotha kori bole nimite kotha kori ase, kelemane taikhan to eku kaam nakore.

segments.source: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
segments.reference: Kunba kotha namana manu ke ekbar-duibar samjai dibi, judi tai arubi kotha namanile taike alag kori dibi,
segments.hypothesis: Ekta poila aru dusra kotha pichete eku eku eku kaam na koribi.

segments.source: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
segments.reference: etu jani kene kun manu bhal rasta chari kene aru paap kori thake, tai nijorke bodnam kori ase.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan jani ase ekjon paapi aru paapi manu ase, nijorke biya kori dise.

segments.source: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
segments.reference: Moi kitia Artemas nohoile Tychicus ke tumi logot pathabo, joldi Nicopolis sheher te ahibi, kelemane moi ta te thanda dinte thaki bole bhabona kori loise.
segments.hypothesis: Jitia moi Artemas apuni khan ke pathai ase, Tychicus, moi logote Nicopolis te ahibole nimite kosis koribi, kelemane moi Zeolis ke ta te te te thaki bole mon korise.

segments.source: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
segments.reference: Para tak Zenas ukil aru Apollos ke pathai dibi, taikhan eku bhi komti nohobo nimite.
segments.hypothesis: Aru niyom likha khan ke pathai dibi, aru Apollos taikhan laga phale jabole nimite, titia eku bhi komti nathakibo.

segments.source: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
segments.reference: Aru biswasi khan bhi bhal kaam kori bole hiki bo lage, aru bisi ki dorkar ase, etu te modot dibo paribo nimite, aru eneka hoile eku kaam nathaka nohobo.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan laga manu khan bhi bhal kaam khan laga bhal kaam kori bole sikhai dibi, titia taikhan eku bhi eku bhi phol nathakibo.

segments.source: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
segments.reference: Ami logote thaka sob pora tumike salam janai ase. Salam di ase jun manu khan biswas te amikhan ke morom kori ase. Apuni khan sob logote Isor laga anugrah thakibo dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Ami logote thaka sob manu khan apnikhan ke salam di ase. Amikhan ke biswas te morom koribi, aru apnikhan sob logote anugrah thakibi. Amen.

segments.source: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
segments.reference: Paul, Jisu Khrista laga koidi, aru moi logote bhai Timothy, duijon pora Philemon ke, jun amikhan laga morom sathi aru susamachar laga prochar korate eke logote kaam kora jon ase,
segments.hypothesis: Paul, Jisu Khrista laga bondhi ghor te thaka Timothy, amikhan laga bhai Timothy, Philemon, amikhan logote morom kora khan,

segments.source: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
segments.reference: aru biswas te amikhan laga bhoini Apphia ke, aru Archippus amikhan laga sipahi ke, aru tumi laga ghor te joma kora girja ke.
segments.hypothesis: Apuni laga ghor te morom thaka manu khan, amikhan laga ekjon sipahi, aru amikhan laga manu, aru apuni laga ghor laga girja te:

segments.source: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.reference: Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha aru shanti tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Baba Isor aru Jisu Khrista laga anugrah apnikhan logote shanti aru shanti apnikhan laga anugrah te thaki bole dibi.

segments.source: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
segments.reference: Moi hodai Isor ke dhanyavad di thake. Moi laga prathana te tumikhan ke yaad kori thake.
segments.hypothesis: Moi Isor ke dhanyavad di ase, moi apnikhan laga prathana te kotha koi thake.

segments.source: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
segments.reference: Tumikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista logote morom aru biswas thaka aru ekjon-ekjon logote thaka to moi hunise.
segments.hypothesis: Apuni laga morom aru biswas laga kotha huni kene thakibi juntu apuni Probhu Jisu aru pobitro manu khan logote ase,

segments.source: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
segments.reference: Moi prathana kori ase tumikhan biswas pora lok kori thaka to amikhan majote Khrista dwara ki bhal ase, etu sob aru bhi bhal pora janibo paribo.
segments.hypothesis: titia apnikhan laga biswas laga sangoti te eke bhal kaam ase, juntu Jisu Khrista logote amikhan logote ase.

segments.source: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
segments.reference: Tumikhan laga morom thaka nimite moi bisi khushi aru aram paise, kelemane, tumi, moi laga bhai, pora pobitro khan laga mon pora taja kori dise.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile apnikhan laga morom te amikhan bisi khushi aru mon dangor ase, etu nimite pobitro manu khan laga mon apnikhan dwara mon dangor hoi jaise.

segments.source: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
segments.reference: Etu karone, moi Khrista laga naam pora mon dangor hoi kene tumikhan ke ki kori bole lage etu hukum dibole pare,
segments.hypothesis: Etu nimite, moi apnikhan ke Khrista laga hukum te mon dangor kori kene ase, juntu thik ase,

segments.source: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
segments.reference: kintu morom thaka nimite, moi tumikhan ke anurodh kori ase- Moi, Paul, ekjon bura manu aru etiya Jisu Khrista nimite ekjon koidi.
segments.hypothesis: kintu morom nimite, moi apnikhan ke anurodh kori bole nimite anurodh kori ase, eneka ekjon jineka Paul, tai laga age te, kintu Jisu Khrista laga bondhi ghor te thaka manu khan bhi.

segments.source: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
segments.reference: Moi laga bacha Onesimus ke bhabona kori kene hudi ase, moi loha laga rusi pora bandhi kene thaka homoi te tai laga baba hoi jaise.
segments.hypothesis: Moi apnikhan ke sa-amokok kori ase, aru moi laga bondhi ghor te thaka ekjon-ekjon laga baba hoise,

segments.source: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
segments.reference: Tai ekta homoi te tumikhan nimite eku kaam laga thaka nai, kintu etiya tai tumi aru moi nimite bisi kaam laga ase.
segments.hypothesis: Ek din apuni khan logote eku kaam nai, kintu etiya etiya etiya apuni khan nimite moi aru bhi bisi bhal ase.

segments.source: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
segments.reference: Moi taike tumikhan logote pathai di ase, tai moi laga bisi morom kora ekjon ase.
segments.hypothesis: Moi taike pathai ase, etu karone, taike grohon koribi, eneka ami laga mon ase,

segments.source: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
segments.reference: Moi itcha thakise, jitia tak moi susamachar prochar kora nimite loha pora bandhi kene ase, titia tak taike moi logote rakhi kene tumikhan laga naam te moike sewa kori bole nimite.
segments.hypothesis: Moi apnikhan nimite moi logote thaki bole mon korise, etu nimite apnikhan laga kotha moi nimite, moi laga bondhi ghor te moi laga hathte Isor laga susamachar nimite moike sewa kori bole nimite.

segments.source: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
segments.reference: Kintu moi tumikhan ke nahudi kene eku kaam kori bole mon nai. Moi tumikhan pora bhal kaam kori thaka to hoile ene pora koribo dibole mon nai, kintu ki bhal kaam kori ase etu bhal itcha pora hobole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu moi apuni laga bhal niyom nathaka nimite eku kaam kori bole mon thakise, etu pora apuni laga niyom to eku kaam nai, kintu ajad thaka nisena nohoi.

segments.source: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
segments.reference: Etu karone tai tumikhan pora olop din nimite alag hoi jaisele, aru etu pora hodai nimite taike tumi wapas pai jobole nimite.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane jitia Tai apnikhan pora alag hoise, titia Tai laga itcha pora apnikhan Taike hodai nimite alag kori dise.

segments.source: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
segments.reference: Tai aru manu laga sewa nokorile, kintu tai ekjon sewa kora manu pora bhi bhal hoi kene morom thaka bhai hobo. Moi taike bisi morom kore, aru tumike bhi bisi morom kore, mangso pora bhi aru Probhu Jisu laga naam pora bhi.
segments.hypothesis: Ekjon noukar nisena nohoi, kintu ekjon noukar nisena he dangor nohoi, ekjon morom thaka bhai, moi nimite, kintu apuni khan ke mangso aru gaw te, Probhu aru Probhu logote ki ase etu pora bhi bisi itcha ase.

segments.source: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
segments.reference: Jodi moi bhi tumikhan laga sathi ase koile, moike jineka tumikhan pora loise etu nisena, taike bhi loi lobi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone, jodi apuni ekjon partner ase koile, taike grohon koribi jineka apuni pora moike pabo.

segments.source: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
segments.reference: Kintu jodi tai tumikhan logote kiba biya korise aru dibole baki ase koile, etu moi uporte hali dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu jodi tai apuni ke eku bhi biya kaam kori kene biya ase koile, apuni ke moi laga hisab te rakhibi.

segments.source: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
segments.reference: Moi, Paul, moi laga nijor hath pora etu likhi ase. Moi nijor sob to wapas kori dibo- aru tumikhan nijorke moi logote dibole baki ase!
segments.hypothesis: Moi Paul, Paul, tai laga hath pora etu likhibi: Moi tumike ki dibole ase etu koi dibo, aru apuni laga nijor itcha pora bhi apuni laga itcha pora moike koi dibo.

segments.source: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
segments.reference: Hoi, bhai, Probhu laga naam pora moi nimite ekta kaam kori dibi; Khrista nimite moi laga mon to taja kori dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Aru bhai, moi Probhu logote khushi pabo, aru Probhu laga mon bhitor te mon dangor koribi. Aru Probhu laga monte mon dangor hoi jabi.

segments.source: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
segments.reference: Tumi pora kotha mani kene thaka to moi bharosa ase. Aru moi kowa kotha pora bhi tumi bisi koribo koi kene moi tumike etu chithi likhi ase.
segments.hypothesis: Apuni laga kotha mani kene thaka nimite, moi apuni khan ke likhi ase, moi jani ase apuni khan ki koi ase etu pora bhi moi apuni laga kotha pora bhi koribo.

segments.source: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
segments.reference: Aru etu logote, etiya moi nimite ekta kamra taiyar kori kene rakhibi, moi asha ase tumi laga prathana pora moi joldi tumi logote wapas ahibo paribo.
segments.hypothesis: Aru moi nimite ghumai ghor taiyari kene taiyar kori thakibi, kele koile moi apuni khan laga prathana te prathana kori kene apuni khan logote moi apuni laga khushi pora apuni khan ke bhal kori dibo.

segments.source: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
segments.reference: Epaphras, Jisu Khrista laga kaam nimite moi logote bondhi ghor te thaka sathi, tai bhi tumike salam jonai ase.
segments.hypothesis: Epaphras, moi laga bondhi ghor te, Jisu Khrista logote, apuni ke salam jonai ase.

segments.source: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
segments.reference: Mark, Aristarach, Demas, aru Luke, moi logot kaam kori thaka khan sob pora bhi salam jonai ase.
segments.hypothesis: Mark nisena kaam kori thaka manu khan, aru moi laga kaam kora manu khan ke bhi, aru ekjon manu ke bhi.

segments.source: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
segments.reference: Jisu Khrista laga anugrah tumikhan sob logot hodai thaki bole dibi. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah apuni laga atma logote thaki bole dibi. Amen.

segments.source: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
segments.reference: Kuntu shuru pora thakise- juntu moi khan hunise, aru suku pora dikhise, juntu moi khan saise, aru amikhan laga hath pora dhorise, eitu khan sob jibon laga kotha ase.
segments.hypothesis: Etu shuru pora shuru pora he amikhan ki hunise etu he he he ase, juntu amikhan dikhise, aru amikhan laga suku pora dikhise, juntu kotha amikhan dikhise aru jibon laga kotha ke chinta korise, etu nimite amikhan laga hath pora jibon laga kaam ke chinta kori dise.

segments.source: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
segments.reference: Aru, etu jibon amikhan ke janibole dise, aru amikhan etu laga gawahi ase. Moi apuni khan ke anonto jibon laga kotha koi ase, jun to Baba Isor logote ase, aru etu kotha amikhan ke janibole nimite dise.
segments.hypothesis: -Sob jibon to dikhai dise, aru amikhan dikhise, aru gawahi di ase, aru tumikhan ke koi ase, anonto jibon aru Baba logote thaka jibon ke koi kene dikhai dise- aru Tai he amikhan ke dikhai dise.

segments.source: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
segments.reference: Amikhan ki hunise aru dikhise, etu sob apuni khan ke koidi ase, etu pora amikhan sob mili kene thakibo. Aru, amikhan Baba aru Tai laga Putro, Jisu Khrista logote milikena ase.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nimite amikhan juntu dikhise aru amikhan apuni khan ke koi ase, apuni khan bhi amikhan logote ekjon-ekjon logote ekjon dushman ase, aru amikhan laga Baba aru Tai laga Putro logote ase.

segments.source: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
segments.reference: Aru, amikhan to apuni khan nimite etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora apuni khan khushi kori thaka to pura hoi jabo nimite.
segments.hypothesis: Aru amikhan etu kotha khan apuni khan ke likhi ase, titia amikhan laga khushi pura hobo.

segments.source: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
segments.reference: Amikhan etu kotha Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista logot pora hunise aru apuni khan ke koi ase: Isor to puhor ase, aru Tai logote eku andhera nai.
segments.hypothesis: Etu kotha amikhan Tai pora huni loise aru etu kotha to hosa ase koi kene koi dise, aru Isor to puhor ase, aru Tai logote eku andhar nai.

segments.source: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
segments.reference: Jodi amikhan Tai logote milikena ase koi aru andhar laga rasta te berai, titia amikhan misa koi ase aru hosa laga kotha khan mani kene thaka nohoi jai.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi amikhan koi ase, amikhan Tai logote mili kene thakibo aru andhera te berabo, aru misa kowa nohoi, aru hosa ke koi nadibi.

segments.source: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
segments.reference: Kintu jodi amikhan ujala te berai jineka Tai ujala te thake, amikhan ekjon-ekjon logote milikena ase, aru Tai laga Putro Jisu laga khun pora amikhan laga sob paap to sapha kori diye.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu jodi amikhan ujala te berabo, titia amikhan ekjon-ekjon logote ekjon-ek-ekjon laga ekjon-ekta logote mili kene ekjon- Jisu Khrista laga Putro ke sapha kori kene amikhan sob paap pora sapha kori dibo.

segments.source: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
segments.reference: Jodi amikhan paap nai koi, titia amikhan nijorke thogai ase, aru hosa to moi khan logote nai.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi amikhan laga paap nai koile, amikhan nijorke thogai ase, aru hosa to amikhan logote nohoi, aru etu nimite hosa to bisi nai.

segments.source: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
segments.reference: Kintu jodi amikhan pora Isor ke amikhan laga paapkhan shikar kore, titia Tai hosa thaka pora amikhan laga paapkhan maph kori dibo aru sob adharmikta pora sapha kori dibo.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi amikhan laga paap shikar korile, Tai hosa aru dharmik ase, Tai amikhan laga paapkhan maph kori dibo aru sob pora sapha kori dibo.

segments.source: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
segments.reference: Jodi amikhan paap kora nai koile, amikhan Taike misa bonai di ase, aru Tai laga kotha amikhan logote nai.
segments.hypothesis: Jodi amikhan pora paap kora nai koi kene koi ase, amikhan taike misa koi ase aru Tai laga kotha amikhan logote nohoi.

segments.source: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
segments.reference: Ami laga bacha khan, moi tumikhan ke etu likhi ase tumikhan paap nokorile nimite. Kintu jodi kunba paap kore, amikhan laga Baba Isor logote kotha kori diya ekjon ase, Jisu Khrista, kun dharmik ase.
segments.hypothesis: Moi laga bacha khan, moi apuni khan ke etu kotha khan likhi ase, etu nimite apuni khan paap nohoi. Jodi kunba paap pora amikhan laga Baba logote ekjon Modot ase, Jisu Khrista, jun khan logote dharmik ase.

segments.source: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
segments.reference: Tai amikhan laga paap maph kori diya ekjon ase, aru khali amikhan ekla nimite nohoi, kintu pura duniya nimite.
segments.hypothesis: Aru Tai amikhan laga paap nimite bolidan kori ase, aru amikhan laga nohoi, kintu pura duniya nimite bhi nohoi.

segments.source: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
segments.reference: Etu pora amikhan Taike jani loise, jodi amikhan Tai laga adesh khan mani kene thake koile.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone amikhan jani ase amikhan taike jani ase: jodi amikhan Tai laga hukum mani thakile, amikhan Tai niyom mani thakile.

segments.source: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
segments.reference: Kun manu koi, “Moi Isor ke jane,” kintu kotha mani kene nathake, tai misa kowa manu ase, aru tai logote hosa nai.
segments.hypothesis: Jun koi ase, "Moi Taike jane," kintu Tai laga hukum mani kene nathake, aru hosa to misa-misi nohoi, aru Tai logote nohoi.

segments.source: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
segments.reference: Kintu kun manu Isor laga kotha mane, tai logot te Isor laga morom to sob phale bhal bonai dise. Etu pora amikhan jane amikhan Tai logote ase:
segments.hypothesis: Kintu Isor laga morom to hosa pora he bhal pora bhal pora mani loise, jun manu Tai laga kotha mani thake, etu amikhan jani ase amikhan Tai logote ki ase?

segments.source: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
segments.reference: kun manu tai Isor logote ase koi, Khrista jineka beraise, etu nisena tai bhi bera bole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Jun koi ase tai nijor bhi bera bole lage, aru berai kene berai thake.

segments.source: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai khan, moi tumikhan ke notun niyom likha nohoi, hoilebi kuntu purana niyom tumikhan logote shuru pora ase, etu he koi ase. Etu purana niyom he tumikhan huni thaka laga kotha ase.
segments.hypothesis: Bhai khan, moi apuni khan ke eku notun kotha likhi bole para nai, kintu apuni khan laga niyom to poila pora huni bole laga hukum ase. Etu poila pora apuni khan ki kotha hunise etu poila pora kotha huni ase.

segments.source: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
segments.reference: Hoilebi moi tumikhan nimite notun niyom likhi di ase, juntu niyom Khrista aru tumikhan usorte hosa ase, kelemane andhera to jai ase, aru hosa laga puhor to juli ase.
segments.hypothesis: Aru bhi, Moi tumikhan nimite notun hukum likhi ase, juntu Tai nimite ase, aru tumikhan logote ase, kelemane andhera to poila hoi kene ujala hoi ase.

segments.source: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
segments.reference: Kun manu ujala te ase eneka koi, aru nijor laga bhai bhoini khan ke ghin kore, tai etiya bhi andhera te ase.
segments.hypothesis: Jun koi ase tai puhor te ase, aru tai laga bhai to andhera te ase jitia tak tai laga maiki to andhera hoi ase.

segments.source: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
segments.reference: Kun manu tai laga bhai ke morom kore tai ujala te ase aru tai kitia bhi biya rasta te nagiribo.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu tai laga bhai ke morom kore tai puhor te thakibo, aru ta te eku bhi bodnam nathakibo.

segments.source: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
segments.reference: Kintu kun manu tai laga bhai ke ghin kore tai andhera te ase aru andhera te berai ase. Tai kote jai ase tai nijor bhi najane, kelemane andhera pora tai laga suku andha kori dise.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu jun manu tai laga bhai ke ghin kore, tai andhar te ase, aru andhera te berai ase, kintu tai kot te jabo etu najane, kelemane andhera tai laga suku andha hoi jaise.

segments.source: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
segments.reference: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, morom laga bacha khan, kelemane Khrista laga naam pora tumikhan laga paap maph paise.
segments.hypothesis: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, bacha khan, kele koile tumikhan laga paap to maph kori dise, kele tumikhan laga naam nimite.

segments.source: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
segments.reference: Moi apuni khan ke likhi ase, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane utu ekjon kun ase, jun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan nimite likhi ase, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan biya ekjon logote jiti loise.
segments.hypothesis: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, baba khan, kele koile tumikhan jani ase, Moi tumikhan nimite likhi ase. Kilekoile tumikhan majote ekjon manu ke biya manu khan ke dhori ase, kele Moi tumikhan logote likhi ase kelemane Baba Isor ke jane.

segments.source: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
segments.reference: Moi tumikhan ke likhi dise, chutu bacha khan, kelemane tumikhan Baba Isor ke jane. Moi etu apuni khan ke likhise, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane etu ekjon ke kun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan ke likhise, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan takot ase, aru Isor laga kotha tumikhan logote ase, aru tumikhan biya uporte jiti loise.
segments.hypothesis: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, baba laga baba khan, kele koile tumikhan jani ase. Moi tumikhan nimite likha ase, bacha khan, kelemane tumikhan Isor laga kotha ase, aru tumikhan laga kotha to dhori kene ase.

segments.source: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
segments.reference: Etu duniya ke morom nokoribi aru etu duniya te thaka jinis khan ke morom nokoribi. Jodi kunba manu etu duniya ke morom kore, titia tai logote Baba Isor laga morom nai.
segments.hypothesis: Etu prithibi ke morom na koribi, nohoile ki ase etu prithibi te nohoi. Jodi kunba duniya ke morom kore, Baba laga morom tai logote nohoi.

segments.source: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
segments.reference: Kelemane ki to etu duniya te ase- mangso laga itcha, aru suku laga itcha, aru jibon laga phutani- etu Baba pora nohoi kintu etu duniya laga ase.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile prithibi laga itcha khan sob to prithibi laga kaam ase, aru suku laga itcha ase, kintu jibon laga itcha aru jibon laga phutani khan ase, hoilebi prithibi laga nohoi, kintu prithibi laga ase.

segments.source: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
segments.reference: Etu duniya aru tai laga itcha khan khotom hoi ase. Kintu kun manu Isor laga itcha pora thake tai hodai thakibo.
segments.hypothesis: Prithibi laga itcha khan logote jai ase, kintu Isor laga itcha pora Tai hodai thakibo.

segments.source: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
segments.reference: Chutu bacha khan, etu hekh laga homoi ase. Tumikhan Khrista bhirodhi ahi ase koi kene hunise, aru etiya to bisi Khrista bhirodhi jon ahi jaise. Etu pora amikhan jane hekh homoi to ahise.
segments.hypothesis: Chutu bacha khan, jitia apuni khan etu homoi te thaka homoi te, apuni khan hunise, apuni ki hunise etu to bisi manu ahi ase, aru etiya bhi bisi manu ahibo. Etu pichete amikhan jani ase.

segments.source: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
segments.reference: Khrista ke bhirodh kora khan to amikhan pora ulaikene jaise, kintu taikhan to amikhan pora nohoi. Jodi taikhan to amikhan pora ase koile amikhan logote thaki bole asele. Kintu jitia taikhan ulaikene jaise, etu pora jani loise taikhan kun bhi amikhan pora nohoi.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan amikhan pora ulai jaise, kintu taikhan amikhan laga nohoi. Kilekoile jodi taikhan amikhan logote thakise koile, taikhan amikhan nimite thakibo thakise, kintu Jisu ke amikhan logote thaki bole dise. Kintu taikhan ke amikhan laga kotha koi dise.

segments.source: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
segments.reference: Kintu tumikhan Pobitro Ekjon pora asirbad paise, aru tumikhan sob hosa jani ase.
segments.hypothesis: Apnikhan Pobitro Pobitro Atma pora ekta tel hali ase, aru tumikhan sob logote gyaan ase.

segments.source: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
segments.reference: Moi tumikhan hosa najane koi kene etu likha nai, kintu tumikhan jani ase aru hosa te eku misa nai.
segments.hypothesis: Moi apuni khan ke likha nai kele koile apuni hosa najane, kintu tumikhan etu jani ase, aru kele koile tumikhan etu najane, aru misa kotha koi ase.

segments.source: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
segments.reference: Kun misa kowa jon ase, tai ekjon, jun pora Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene mana kore? Etu manu Khrista bhirodhi ase, kelemane tai Baba aru Putro ke mana kori ase.
segments.hypothesis: Kun he misa koi ase, kintu jun Jisu Khrista ase? Etu to Antichrist ase, jun Baba aru Putro ke dangor kore.

segments.source: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
segments.reference: Kun manu Jisu ke mana kore tai laga Baba nai. Kun manu Jisu ke loi, tai logote Baba ase.
segments.hypothesis: Jun Putro logote nakhibi, tai Baba ke namanibo. Jun Putro ke Tai laga naam mani loi, Tai Baba ke bhi shikar kore.

segments.source: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
segments.reference: Aru tumikhan to, shuru pora ki kotha hunise etu tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi. Jodi tumikhan shuru pora ki hunise etu monte rakhe koile, tumikhan hodai Putro aru Baba logote thakibo.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone, apuni khan nisena, apuni laga kotha khan poila pora huni kene thakibi. Jodi apuni khan poila hunise, apuni bhi Putro logote thakibo, aru Apuni Baba logote thakibo.

segments.source: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
segments.reference: Etu kosom Khrista pora amikhan ke dise- anonto jibon.
segments.hypothesis: Etu kosom ase, Tai amikhan ke anonto jibon dise.

segments.source: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
segments.reference: Moi etu kotha tumikhan nimite likhi ase, utu manu karone bhi kun pora tumikhan ke biya rasta te loijabo.
segments.hypothesis: Etu sob kotha khan nimite moi apuni khan ke thogai dibo.

segments.source: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
segments.reference: Aru tumikhan to, ki asirbad tumikhan Khrista pora paise etu tumikhan logote he ase, aru dusra pora tumikhan ke sikhai dibole dorkar nai. Kintu Tai laga asirbad pora ki sikhai dise etu hosa ase aru misa nohoi, aru tumikhan ke sikhai diya nisena, Tai logote thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile apuni khan laga naam te, apuni khan pora ki kaam korise etu kori kene apuni khan ke sikhai dibole nimite eku bhi nai, kintu Tai laga bhal kaam khan sikhai diya nisena, aru apuni khan bhi etu kotha khan ke hikai dibo, aru etu to apuni khan nimite thakibo.

segments.source: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
segments.reference: Etiya, bacha khan, Tai logote thakibi, jitia Tai wapas ahibo, moi khan mon dangor koribo aru Tai aha homoi te sorom nakhabo.
segments.hypothesis: Etiya, bacha khan, Jisu logote thaki bole nimite, jitia Tai ahibo, amikhan mon dangor hoi kene Tai laga ahibole nimite sorom nohobo.

segments.source: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
segments.reference: Jodi tumi jane Tai dharmik ase koi kene, titia hoile tumikhan etu bhi jani thakibo kun manu thik kaam kore tai Isor pora jonom hoise.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi tumikhan jani ase Tai dharmik ase koi kene jani ase, jun manu khan jane, tai laga dharmikta pora jonom korise.

segments.source: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
segments.reference: Sabi Isor pora kineka morom amikhan ke dise, eneka pora amikhan Isor laga bacha ase kobole nimite, aru hosa pora bhi amikhan to Tai laga bacha khan ase. Etu karone, prithibi pora amikhan ke najane, kelemane taikhan Isor ke najane.
segments.hypothesis: Sabi, Baba pora amikhan ke kiman morom dise, etu nisena amikhan ke Isor laga bacha khan koi kene matibo. Etu prithibi pora amikhan najane, kelemane etu prithibi amikhan ke najane, kele koile Tai Taike najane.

segments.source: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan etiya Isor laga bacha khan ase aru amikhan ki hobo etu etiya bhi dikhai diya nai. Amikhan jane jitia Khrista ahibo, amikhan Tai nisena hoi jabo, kelemane Tai kineka ase etu nisena amikhan Taike dikhibo.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, etiya amikhan Isor laga bacha khan ase. Amikhan ki hobole ase etu bhi najane, kintu jitia Tai dikhai dibo, amikhan Tai nisena hobo, kelemane Tai amikhan Taike dikhibo.

segments.source: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
segments.reference: Kun manu Khrista uporte asha rakhe, Khrista sapha thaka nisena, etu manu khan bhi nijorke sapha kori loi.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu etu asha kore, tai nijorke puri thaka nisena sapha ase.

segments.source: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
segments.reference: Kun paap kaam khan kori ase tai niyom khan mani kene thaka manu nohoi, kelemane paap te niyom nai.
segments.hypothesis: Jun paap kore taikhan bhi niyom nathaka kaam kori ase, aru niyom nathaka ase.

segments.source: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
segments.reference: Tumikhan jane Khrista ke dikhai diya to paapkhan hatai dibole nimite hoise, aru Tai logote eku paap nai.
segments.hypothesis: Apnikhan jani ase Tai amikhan laga paap to loi jabole dikhai dise, aru paap tai logote eku paap nai.

segments.source: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
segments.reference: Kun manu Khrista logote thake, tai aru paap kaam nakore. Aru kun manu paap kaam kore, tai Isor ke dikha nai, aru Taike janibole para nai.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu tai logote thake tai paap nakore, tai laga paap to kun pora bhi dikhi kene nai, aru kun paap pora taike najane.

segments.source: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
segments.reference: Morom laga bacha khan, kun pora bhi tumike biya rasta te loi jabole nadibi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai dharmik ase, Khrista dharmik thaka nisena.
segments.hypothesis: Chutu bacha khan, kun bhi tumike thogai nadibi. Jun manu apuni khan ke dharmik kore, tai dharmik ase, jineka Tai dharmik ase.

segments.source: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
segments.reference: Kun manu paap kaam khan kore tai saitan laga ase, kelemane saitan bhi shuru pora paap kaam kori kene ahise. Etu nimite Isor laga Putro ke dikhai dise, aru Tai pora saitan laga kaam khan khotom kori dibole.
segments.hypothesis: Jun paap to bhoot laga ase, tai he poila pora paap korise, aru Isor laga Putro ke dikhai dise, etu pora Tai bhoot laga kaam khan ke khotom kori dibo.

segments.source: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
segments.reference: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai biya kaam kori kene nathake kelemane Isor laga bijon tai logote ase. Tai paap kori kene thaki bole napare kelemane tai Isor pora jonom hoise.
segments.hypothesis: Jun Isor laga jonom te ase, tai paap kora nohoi, kelemane tai laga bijon tai logote thake, aru tai laga khandan tai logote thaki ase, aru Tai paap to Isor laga bacha nisena ase, kelemane Tai Isor laga itcha ase.

segments.source: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
segments.reference: Etu pora Isor laga bacha khan aru saitan laga bacha khan ke dikhai diye: Kun manu dharmik kaam nakore tai Isor laga nohoi, aru kun manu tai nijor laga bhai ke morom nakore tai bhi Isor laga nohoi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu jagate Isor laga bacha khan ke dikhai dise, aru bhoot laga bacha bacha khan ase, aru jun Isor laga dharmikta nohoi, tai bhi tai laga bhai ke morom nakore.

segments.source: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
segments.reference: Kelemane tumikhan shuru pora etu kotha huni kene ahise, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile etu kotha to poila pora huni kene ase, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo lage.

segments.source: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
segments.reference: Amikhan Cain nisena nohobole lage, kun biya ekjon pora ahise aru nijor bhai ke morai dise. Ki nimite taike morai dise? Kelemane tai laga kaam khan paap laga kaam khan thakise aru tai laga bhai Abel laga kaam khan dharmik kaam khan thakise.
segments.hypothesis: Ekjon manu pora biya kaam kora manu ke chari kene morai dise, aru tai laga bhai ke morai dise? Kelemane tai laga kaam biya thakise, aru etu nimite tai laga biya kaam khan biya thakise.

segments.source: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
segments.reference: Tumikhan asurit nalagibi, ami laga bhai khan, jodi tumike etu duniya pora ghin kore.
segments.hypothesis: Moi laga bhai khan, jodi duniya pora tumikhan ke ghin kore, tumikhan ke bhi ghin kore.

segments.source: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
segments.reference: Amikhan mora pora ulaikene jibon paise, kelemane moi khan bhai ke morom kore. Kun manu morom te nathake tai mori kene ase.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan jani ase amikhan jibon te mora pora mori jaise, kelemane amikhan bhai khan ke morom kore. Jun manu tai laga morom nakore, tai laga bhai ke mora te thaki ase.

segments.source: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
segments.reference: Kun manu nijor bhai ke morom nakore tai manu morai diya manu ase. Tumi jane manu morai diya manu ke kitia bhi anonto jibon tai logote thaki bole na paribo.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu tai laga bhai ke ghin kore, tai manu ke najane, aru tumikhan najane, kintu tumikhan najane jun manu morai nadibo, tai uporte anonto jibon nathakibo.

segments.source: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
segments.reference: Etu pora amikhan morom to jane, kelemane Khrista amikhan nimite Tai laga jibon dise. Amikhan bhi nijor laga bhai khan nimite jibon dibole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone amikhan jani ase, kelemane Tai amikhan nimite Tai laga jibon dise, aru amikhan bhai khan nimite amikhan laga jibon dibo lage.

segments.source: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
segments.reference: Kintu kun manu logote duniya laga sob saman ase, aru tai laga bhai dukh te thaka dikhile bhi, bhai nimite tai laga mon bondh kori kene rakhe, titia hoile tai logote Isor laga morom kote ase?
segments.hypothesis: Kintu jun manu logote duniya laga bhal ase aru tai laga bhai ke bhal pora sai ase, titia tai laga mon dangor ase, Isor laga morom morom to kineka ase?

segments.source: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
segments.reference: Ami laga morom bacha khan, amikhan khali kotha aru mukh pora morom nokorile, kintu kaam aru hosa pora morom koribo.
segments.hypothesis: Moi laga bacha khan, ekta kotha te morom kora nohoi, nohoile jiba pora he, aru hosa aru hosa te.

segments.source: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
segments.reference: Etu pora amikhan jani loi amikhan hosa te ase, aru amikhan laga mon Isor usorte rakhi diye.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nimite amikhan jani ase amikhan hosa laga ase aru amikhan Tai laga mon usorte khushi kori ase.

segments.source: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
segments.reference: Jodi amikhan laga mon pora amikhan ke biya ase koi, Isor to amikhan laga mon pora bhi dangor ase, aru Tai sob jinis khan jani ase.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane jodi amikhan laga mon pora golti dibo, Isor to amikhan laga monte thaka pora bhi dangor ase, aru sob jane.

segments.source: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai khan, jodi amikhan laga nijor mon pora amikhan ke bodnam nadiye, titia amikhan Isor uporte bharosa ase.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, amikhan laga mon laga kotha khan pora amikhan ke bodnam nakore, titia amikhan Isor phale mon dangor kori ase.

segments.source: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
segments.reference: Amikhan ki mange etu pai jabo, kelemane amikhan Tai laga kotha mani kene thake aru Tai ki khushi pai eitu khan kore.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone amikhan ki mangibo, etu sob Tai laga kotha mani kene mani loi, kele koile amikhan Tai laga niyom mani loi aru Tai laga age te ki khushi ase etu kori ase.

segments.source: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
segments.reference: Etu Tai laga kotha khan ase: amikhan Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista ke biswas koribo aru ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo, Tai pora etu kotha amikhan ke diya nisena.
segments.hypothesis: Etu tai laga hukum ase, amikhan Tai laga Putro laga naam te biswas koribo, Jisu Khrista, aru ekjon-ekjon ke morom kore, jineka Tai pora ki hukum dise etu bhi biswas koribo.

segments.source: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
segments.reference: Tai laga kotha mani kene thaka manu to Tai logot thake, aru Tai bhi taikhan logote ase. Tai amikhan logote ase koi kene jane Atma dwara jane, junke Tai pora amikhan nimite dise.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu Tai laga hukum mani loi, tai Tai logote thake, aru Tai laga naam Tai logote thaki ase, Tai amikhan logote thaki bole pare, juntu Atma pora amikhan ke dise.

segments.source: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai khan, sob atma ke biswas nokoribi. Kintu, kuntu atma Isor pora ase etu bhal pora sai lobi, kelemane bisi misa bhabobadi khan prithibi te ulaikene ase.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, sob atma ke biswas nakore, kintu Isor laga itcha pora taikhan ke porikha koribi, kelemane bisi misa bhabobadi khan prithibi te jai jaise.

segments.source: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
segments.reference: Etu pora tumikhan Isor laga Atma to janibo- kun manu Jisu Khrista to sharir hoi kene Isor pora ahise koi kene shikar kore,
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone apnikhan Isor laga Atma jani ase: jun manu Jisu Khrista laga gaw te Tai laga gaw ase koi kene biswas kore,

segments.source: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
segments.reference: aru kun atma pora Jisu to Isor pora ahise koi kene shikar nakore. Etu Khrista bhirodh kora laga atma ase, jun ahibole ase koi kene tumikhan hunise, aru etiya tai prithibi te ahi jaise.
segments.hypothesis: aru jun atma ase, jun khan Jisu Khrista laga gaw mangso te aha nai, aru Isor laga atma ase. Etu to ekjon hosar ase, junke tumikhan hunise, etu prithibi te ahi ase. Etiya prithibi te ase.

segments.source: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
segments.reference: Tumikhan Isor pora ase, morom laga bacha khan, aru taikhan ke jiti loise, kelemane etu ekjon kun tumi logote ase Tai etu duniya te thaka ekjon pora bhi sobse dangor ase.
segments.hypothesis: Apnikhan to Isor laga bacha khan ase, bacha khan, aru tumikhan laga bhitor te thaka pora bhi dangor ase, kelemane jun khan prithibi te ase, tai tumikhan nimite bhi dangor manu ase.

segments.source: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
segments.reference: Taikhan duniya laga ase; etu nimite taikhan ki koi etu duniya laga he ase, aru duniya laga manu khan taikhan laga kotha he hune.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan duniya laga ase. Etu karone taikhan duniya laga kotha koi ase, aru duniya taikhan taikhan etu huni ase.

segments.source: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
segments.reference: Amikhan Isor pora ase. Kun manu Isor ke jane amikhan laga kotha hune. Aru kun manu Isor pora nohoi amikhan laga kotha nahune. Etu pora amikhan jane hosa laga atma aru misa laga atma.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan Isor laga ase. Tai kun he Isor laga kotha jani ase, Tai he amikhan laga nohoi, aru Isor laga atma pora amikhan laga kotha hunibo napare. Etu pora amikhan hosa laga atma jani ase.

segments.source: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo, kelemane morom to Isor pora he ahe, aru kun manu morom kore tai Isor pora jonom loise, kelemane Isor to morom ase.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi, kelemane Isor laga morom to ase, aru jun Isor ke morom kore, aru Isor ke jonom korise, aru Tai Isor ke jani ase.

segments.source: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
segments.reference: Kun manu morom kori bole najane tai Isor ke najane, kelemane Isor to morom ase.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu Isor ke morom nakore, tai Isor ke najane, kelemane Tai Isor morom kore.

segments.source: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
segments.reference: Kelemane Isor laga etu morom amikhan ke dikhai diya nimite, Isor pora Tai laga ekjon morom thaka Putro ke duniya te pathai dise aru etu pora moi khan sob Tai logote jinda hoi jabo.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone Isor laga morom amikhan ke dikhai dise, Isor pora Tai laga ekjon Putro ke pathai dise, etu prithibi te amikhan jinda thakibo.

segments.source: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
segments.reference: Etu laga morom to, amikhan pora Isor ke morom kora karone nohoi, kintu Tai pora amikhan ke morom korise, aru Tai amikhan ke Tai laga Putro pathaise amikhan ke paap pora bacha bole nimite.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone morom to morom ase, amikhan Isor ke morom kora nohoi, kintu Tai amikhan ke morom korise, aru Tai laga Putro ke amikhan laga paap nimite bolidan dibole nimite dibole nimite pathaise.

segments.source: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai khan, jodi Isor pora amikhan ke iman morom korise, titia hoile amikhan bhi ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, jodi Isor amikhan ke etu nisena morom kore, amikhan bhi ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo lage.

segments.source: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
segments.reference: Kun manu bhi Isor ke kitia bhi dikha nai. Jodi amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kore, Isor amikhan logote thake, aru Tai laga morom to amikhan logot bhal bonai diye.
segments.hypothesis: Kun bhi Isor ke kitia bhi dikha nai. Jodi amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kore, Isor amikhan logote thaki ase, aru Tai laga morom to amikhan logote thik ase.

segments.source: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
segments.reference: Etu pora Isor amikhan logote ase koi kene jane, kelemane Tai laga Atma amikhan ke dise.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone amikhan jani ase amikhan Tai logote aru Tai amikhan logote thaki ase, kelemane Tai amikhan ke Tai laga Atma dise.

segments.source: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
segments.reference: Aru, amikhan dikhise aru etu laga gawahi ase Baba pora Tai laga Putro ke etu duniya laga Tran-korta hobole pathaise.
segments.hypothesis: Aru Tai dikhise aru Baba Baba he duniya laga Tran-Korta ke sakhi di ase.

segments.source: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
segments.reference: Kun manu nijor laga mukh pora shikar kore Jisu he Isor laga Putro ase koi kene, Isor tai logote ase aru tai bhi Isor logote ase.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu Jisu laga Putro ase, tai Isor laga Putro, Isor laga naam loi kene Tai logote thake aru Tai Tai logote Tai Tai laga naam ase.

segments.source: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
segments.reference: Aru, Isor pora amikhan ke morom kora to janise aru biswas korise. Isor to morom ase, aru kun manu etu morom te thake tai Isor logote ase, aru Isor bhi tai logote ase.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan jane Isor laga morom morom thaka morom morom to amikhan nimite ase. Isor to morom ase, aru jun Isor ke morom kore, aru Isor Isor laga naam te thaki ase, Tai Tai logote thaki ase.

segments.source: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
segments.reference: Etu nimite, morom to amikhan laga majote bhal bonai dise, etu pora amikhan bisar kora laga dinte bharosa kori kene thakibo, kelemane Khrista thaka nisena, amikhan bhi etu duniya te thaki ase.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone morom pora amikhan majote thik kaam korise, etu nimite amikhan bisar kora dinte mon dangor hobo, kelemane Tai jineka Tai ase, etu nisena amikhan bhi etu prithibi te ase.

segments.source: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
segments.reference: Morom te eku bhoi nai. Kintu, hosa morom pora sob bhoi phelai diye, kelemane bhoi to sajai pabole nimite ase. Kintu kun manu bhoi kore, morom to tai logote nai.
segments.hypothesis: Morom te bhoi na nai. Kintu, thik morom laga takot pora takot kori kene phelai dibole nimite bhoi koribi, kelemane kun manu bhoi kore, tai laga bhoi ase.

segments.source: We love him, because he first loved us.
segments.reference: Amikhan morom kore kelemane Isor pora poila amikhan ke morom korise.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan taike morom kore, kelemane Tai amikhan ke bisi morom kore.

segments.source: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
segments.reference: Jodi kunba manu koi, “Moi Isor ke morom kore,” kintu nijor laga bhai ke ghin kore, tai misa koi ase. Kun manu tai laga nijor bhai ke morom nakore, kun tai dikhise, Isor ke kitia bhi morom kori bole na paribo, kunke tai dikha nai.
segments.hypothesis: Jodi kunba koi, "Moi Isor ke morom kore, aru tai laga bhai ke ghin kore, tai misa koi ase, kelemane jun manu tai laga morom nakore, tai kineka dikhi ase? Tai Isor ke dikha nai naki?

segments.source: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
segments.reference: Aru, etu he sikhai diya kotha ase kun to amikhan Khrista nimite rakhise, kun manu Isor ke morom kore tai nijor laga bhai ke bhi morom kori bole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Etu hukum amikhan logote ase, jun Isor ke morom kore, tai bhi tai laga bhai ke bhi morom koribo lage.

segments.source: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
segments.reference: Kun manu Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene biswas kore tai Isor pora jonom loise, aru kun manu Isor ke morom kore, Tai jonom kora bacha ke bhi morom kore.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu Jisu Khrista laga ase, tai Isor laga jonom hoise, aru jun Baba ke bhi morom kore, tai laga bacha ke bhi bacha jonom kore.

segments.source: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
segments.reference: Etu pora jane amikhan Isor laga bacha khan ke morom kore, jitia amikhan Isor ke morom kore aru Tai laga hukum khan ke mane.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone amikhan jani ase amikhan Isor laga bacha khan ke morom kore, jitia amikhan Isor ke morom koribo aru Tai laga hukum khan mani thake.

segments.source: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
segments.reference: Kelemane etu he Isor nimite morom ase: amikhan Tai laga hukum khan mani kene thaka to. Tai laga hukum khan bhari nohoi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu to morom kora Isor ase, amikhan Tai laga niyom mani kene mani thake. Tai laga hukum khan bisi dukh nohoi.

segments.source: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
segments.reference: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai duniya ke jiti loise. Etu pora amikhan duniya ke jiti loise, aru amikhan laga biswas bhi.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile juntu Isor pora jonom hoise, etu prithibi ke jiti lobo, aru etu sob to jiti loise: tumi laga biswas to jiti lobo.

segments.source: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
segments.reference: Kelemane duniya ke jiti bole para jon to dusra nohoi kintu jun pora Jisu to Isor laga Putro ase koi kene biswas kori loise.
segments.hypothesis: Kun he prithibi ke jiti bole pare, kintu jun biswas kore, tai Isor laga Putro ase?

segments.source: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
segments.reference: Etu ekjon ase kun pani aru khun pora ahise: Jisu Khrista. Tai khali pani pora aha nai, kintu pani aru khun pora ahise. Etu Pobitro Atma pora he gawahi dise kelemane Atma to hosa ase.
segments.hypothesis: Etu tai he ase jun pani aru khun pora ahise, aru Jisu Khrista logote pani pora ahise. Kintu khun aru khun aru Atma laga ase, jun Atma ase, kelemane Tai hosa ase.

segments.source: For there are three who testify:
segments.reference: Kelemane ta te tinjon ase kun etu laga gawah ase:
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile jun khan laga gawahi ase, taikhan to tinjon ase:

segments.source: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
segments.reference: Atma, aru pani, aru khun. Etu tinta eke logote mili kene ase.
segments.hypothesis: Atma, pani aru khun, aru etu khun, kintu tin bhag to ekta nisena bhabona kori ase.

segments.source: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
segments.reference: Jodi amikhan pora manu khan laga gawahi loi, Isor laga gawahi he etu pora bhi dangor ase. Kelemane Isor laga gawahi to eneka ase, Tai pora he Tai laga Putro laga gawahi dise.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi amikhan manu laga gawahi pabo, Isor laga gawahi to dangor ase, kelemane etu Isor laga kotha Tai laga Putro laga gawahi juntu Tai laga gawahi Tai laga kotha koi dise.

segments.source: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
segments.reference: Kun manu Isor laga Putro ke biswas kore, tai nijor laga gawahi ase. Kun manu Isor ke biswas nakore Taike misa bonai dise, kelemane tai Isor pora Tai laga Putro laga gawahi diya to biswas kora nai.
segments.hypothesis: Jun Isor laga Putro ke biswas kore, Tai nijor uporte gawahi dise, Tai Isor ke biswas nakore, Tai misa misa-misi kotha khan koi kene biswas kore kelemane Tai laga Putro nimite biswas kora nai.

segments.source: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
segments.reference: Etu gawahi ase: Isor amikhan ke anonto jibon dise, aru etu jibon Tai laga Putro Jisu logote ase.
segments.hypothesis: Etu gawahi to etu ase: Isor he amikhan ke anonto jibon dise, aru etu jibon to Tai laga Putro ase.

segments.source: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
segments.reference: Kun manu logote Jisu ase tai jibon paise. Kintu kun manu logote Isor laga Putro Jisu nai tai jibon panai.
segments.hypothesis: Jun Putro logote jibon ase, tai logote jibon nai, aru jun logote Isor laga Putro nai, tai laga jibon nai.

segments.source: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
segments.reference: Moi tumikhan ke etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora tumikhan anonto jibon ase koi kene janibo- tumikhan kun Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista laga naam te biswas kore.
segments.hypothesis: Etu sob to moi apuni khan ke biswas kori ase jun Isor laga Putro laga naam te biswas kore, titia apuni anonto jibon pabo, aru apuni khan Isor laga chokra ke biswas koribo, aru Apuni Isor laga naam pora biswas koribo.

segments.source: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
segments.reference: Aru, etu bharosa amikhan Isor logote ase koi kene jane, jodi Tai laga itcha hisab te amikhan mange, Tai amikhan ke hunibo.
segments.hypothesis: Etu mon dangor ase, amikhan Tai laga kotha koi kene, jodi amikhan Tai nijor itcha hisab te kiba mangibo, Tai amikhan laga kotha huni loi.

segments.source: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
segments.reference: Aru, jodi Isor amikhan ke hune koi kene jane- amikhan Tai logote ki mangibo- Tai logote moi khan ki mangise etu sob paise koi kene jane.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi amikhan laga kotha hunile, amikhan jani ase amikhan ki mangibo, amikhan jane, amikhan tai laga petition ase.

segments.source: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
segments.reference: Jodi kunba manu tai laga bhai ke paap kaam kori thaka dikhe aru etu pora mora nai koile, tai prathana kori bole lage, aru Isor pora taike jibon dibo. Moi eitu khan ke koi ase kun paap kori kene mora to dikha nai. Kunba paap to mora dikhi pai; Moi etu nimite prathana kori bole lage koi kene kowa nai.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jodi kunba bhai ke manu khan laga paap to mrityu laga usorte nabujai, tai pora Isor ke hudibo, aru Isor pora paap pora mora ke morai dibo. Etu nimite paap to moi etu kotha koi dibo.

segments.source: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
segments.reference: Dharmik nathaka kaam khan sob paap ase, kintu kunba paap karone mora laga sajai nadiye.
segments.hypothesis: Sob paap ase, aru paap to mora bole laga paap nohoi.

segments.source: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
segments.reference: Amikhan jane kun manu Isor pora jonom hoise tai paap nakore. Kintu tai ekjon kun Isor pora jonom hoise taike bachai kene rakhe, aru dusto atma pora taike dukh dibole na paribo.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan jane Isor laga paap to kun pora jonom kore, tai he ase jun Isor pora jonom korise, aru Tai nijor uporte eku golti nathaka nai.

segments.source: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
segments.reference: Amikhan Isor pora ase koi kene jane, aru amikhan jane pura duniya to ekjon biya thaka laga sakti te ase.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan jani ase amikhan Isor laga ase, aru pura prithibi to biya manu laga hokti te ase.

segments.source: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
segments.reference: Kintu amikhan jane Isor laga Putro pora ahi kene amikhan ke gyaan dise, etu pora Tai hosa ase koi kene moi khan janibo. Aru, moi khan Tai logote ase kun hosa ase, Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista. Etu ekjon hosa Isor aru anonto jibon ase.
