segments.hypothesis: Isor laga Putro ahise aru amikhan ke bujhi bole laga gyaan dise, aru amikhan jani ase, jun hosa ase, aru Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista logote ase, Tai laga hosa ase. Etu Isor to hosa ase aru anonto jibon Isor ase.

segments.source: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
segments.reference: Bacha khan, nijorke murti puja kora khan pora bachai kene thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Chutu bacha khan, murti pora thakibi.

segments.source: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
segments.reference: Bura manu pora basi luwa mahila aru tai laga bacha khan ke likhi ase, kunkhan ke moi hosa te morom kore- aru moi ekla nohoi, kintu sobke kun hosa janise-
segments.hypothesis: Etu dangor manu khan, jun khan ke basi luwa aru tai laga bacha khan ke morom kore, tai hosa te morom kore aru moi he nohoi, kintu jun khan sob hosa jani ase,

segments.source: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
segments.reference: kelemane hosa to amikhan logote thaki ase aru etu hodai nimite amikhan logote thakibo.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane hosa nimite, juntu amikhan logote thake, aru etu amikhan logote thakibo, aru hodai nimite thakibo.

segments.source: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
segments.reference: Anugrah, daya, aru shanti Baba Isor aru Jisu Khrista laga asirbad tumikhan logote thakibi, jun Putro laga Baba ase, hosa aru morom te.
segments.hypothesis: anugraha, daya aru shanti amikhan logote thakibo, aru Baba Isor aru Jisu Khrista laga Baba laga Baba, hosa aru morom aru morom te morom thakibi.

segments.source: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
segments.reference: Moi bisi khushi kori ase etu huni kene tumikhan laga kunba bacha khan hosa laga rasta te berai ase, jineka amikhan Baba khan pora amikhan etu hukum to paise.
segments.hypothesis: Moi bisi khushi ase, moi apnikhan laga bacha khan ke hosa te berabo, jineka jineka Baba pora amikhan ke Baba pora hukum dise.

segments.source: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
segments.reference: Etiya moi tumike anurodh kori ase, mahila- moi tumike notun hukum likhi kene dibole nimite nohoi, kintu shuru pora juntu thakise- amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Etiya ami apnikhan ke utsah kori ase, morom thaka mahila, ami apnikhan nimite ekta notun hukum likhi ase, kintu amikhan utu shuru pora apnikhan ke morom kore, titia amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole nimite.

segments.source: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
segments.reference: Etu morom ase, ki amikhan Tai laga hukum hisab te berai kene jabole lage. Etu hukum ase juntu shuru pora tumi hunise juntu laga rasta te tumi bera bole lage.
segments.hypothesis: Etu morom ase, amikhan Tai laga hukum hisab te berabo. Etu hukum ase jineka apuni khan pora huni kene thakibo, titia apuni etu jaga te berabo lage.

segments.source: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
segments.reference: Kelemane manu khan ke thogai diya duniya te bisi jai kene ase, aru taikhan etu shikar nakore Jisu Khrista sharir hoi kene ahise. Tai thogai diya manu aru Khrista bhirodhi ase.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile bisi thogai diya manu khan prithibi te jaise, jun khan Jisu Khrista ke misa-misi pora shikar nakore, aru kun manu khan ase taikhan ke paap laga naam ase koi kene mani loise.

segments.source: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
segments.reference: Nijorke sai lobi, amikhan ki nimite kaam kori sele tumi etu naharabo karone, kintu etu pora tumi pura iman to pabo.
segments.hypothesis: Nijor pora sai thakibi, amikhan ki kaam korise etu harai nadibi, kintu amikhan pura paap pabo.

segments.source: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
segments.reference: Kun manu Jisu Khrista pora ki sikhai dise etu noloikene age jai, titia hoile tai logote Isor nai. Kun manu etu kotha khan mani kene thake, tai logote Baba aru Putro duijon bhi ase.
segments.hypothesis: Jun manu khan ke thik pora sai, aru Khrista laga kotha khan te nathake, tai logote Isor laga kotha nai, aru kun Baba aru sikhai ase, Tai he Baba aru Putro logote thaki ase.

segments.source: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
segments.reference: Kun manu tumi laga usorte ahe aru eneka nahikai, taike ghor bhitor te namati bhi aru taike salam nadibi.
segments.hypothesis: Jodi kunba apuni logote ahi ase, aru apuni laga ghor te najabi, titia taike apuni laga manu ke salam nadibi,

segments.source: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
segments.reference: Kun taike salam diye, tai laga biya kaam khan te tai bhi bhag loijai.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane kun manu Taike bhal kaam kori kene tai laga biya kaam kori bole nimite bhal kaam koribo.

segments.source: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
segments.reference: Moi tumikhan logote bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kagos te aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan likhi bole mon nai. Hoilebi, moi tumikhan logote ahi kene ekjon-ekjon logote kotha kori bole mon ase, etu pora tumikhan laga khushi aru bhi bisi dangor hobo.
segments.hypothesis: Apuni khan logote bisi kaam ase, moi bisi kheti aru kaam kori bole napare, kintu moi apuni khan ke mon dangor kori bole asha ase, aru apuni khan laga chehera te kobole nimite, aru etu pora amikhan laga khushi to pura hobo.

segments.source: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
segments.reference: Tumikhan pora basi luwa bhoini laga bacha khan pora bhi tumike salam di ase.
segments.hypothesis: Apuni laga ekjon bhai laga bacha khan apuni ke salam kori ase. Amen.

segments.source: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
segments.reference: Bura manu pora morom thaka Gaius ekjon cholawta ke likhi ase, kunke moi hosa pora morom kore.
segments.hypothesis: Aru tai laga morom thaka manu khan ke Gaius ke, jun khan moi hosa te morom kore.

segments.source: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai, Moi prathana kore tumi logote sob bhal thakibo aru tumi laga gaw bhi bhal thakibo, tumi laga atma bhal kori kene thaka nisena.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, moi prathana kori ase, apuni khan sob kaam te bhal hoi kene, apuni laga atma nisena apuni khan laga bhal hoi jabo.

segments.source: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
segments.reference: Kelemane moi khushi pai jitia bhai khan ahi kene tumi hosa te berai thaka laga gawahi diye, tumi hosa te berai thaka nisena.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane moi bisi khushi kori ase jitia bhai khan ahi kene hosa kotha koi dise, jineka apuni khan hosa te berai ase.

segments.source: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
segments.reference: Moi etu pora aru dangor khushi nai, jitia ami laga bacha khan hosa rasta te berai ase koi kene moi hune.
segments.hypothesis: Moi etu pora bhi bisi khushi nai: ami laga bacha khan hosa te berai thaka hunise.

segments.source: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai, tumi biswas pora ki kori ase etu tumi bhai khan nimite aru bahar manu khan nimite kori ase
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, apuni khan ekjon bhal kaam kori ase, apuni ki kaam kori kene ase etu te apuni khan nijor bhai aru dusra manu khan nimite kaam kori thake.

segments.source: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
segments.reference: kun pora tumikhan laga morom kora laga gawahi girja manu khan laga usorte dise. Isor laga usorte bhal mohima hobole nimite tumi manu ke bhal pora saikene taikhan ke safar kori bole pathai dibi,
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan girja usorte morom laga gawahi dise, aru tumikhan bhal pora taikhan ke Isor laga modot te pathai dibo,

segments.source: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
segments.reference: kelemane Isor laga naam nimite taikhan ulaikene jaise, aru Porjati manu khan pora eku luwa nai.
segments.hypothesis: Kelemane taikhan laga naam nimite, taikhan Najaja manu khan pora eku bhi loi jaise, Porjati khan pora kiba loi jabole nimite.

segments.source: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
segments.reference: Amikhan bhi taikhan ke mati bole lage, etu pora amikhan bhi hosa te kaam kora sathi hoi jabo.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone amikhan eneka manu khan ke grohon kori bole lage, etu nimite amikhan hosa nimite kaam kori bole nimite amikhan logote kaam kori ase.

segments.source: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
segments.reference: Moi manu khan nimite kiba likhise, kintu Diotrephes, kun manu laga age te thaki bole nimite bhal pai, tai amikhan ke swekar nakore.
segments.hypothesis: Moi girja te likha ase, kintu amikhan ke bisi morom kore, kintu etu girja laga kotha to amikhan laga kotha ke mani bole napare.

segments.source: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
segments.reference: Jodi moi ahe, Moi tai ki kaam kori ase etu sabo, amikhan laga bhirodh te biya kotha kori ase. Kintu eneka kori kene bhi khushi panai, tai nijor pora bhi bhai kokai khan ke mati bole mon nai, aru kun manu ke mati bole mon kore taikhan ke rukhai diye aru girja laga bahar te ulai diye.
segments.hypothesis: Etu karone jodi moi ahibo, titia tai ki kaam kori ase etu ke mon dangor koribo, aru etu kotha khan ke biya kotha pora bhi bodnam koribo napare, aru bhai khan ke namanibo, aru girja laga kotha khan pora taike chari dibo.

segments.source: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
segments.reference: Morom laga bhai, biya kaam khan nokoribi kintu ki to bhal kaam ase etu he koribi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai Isor laga ase; aru kun manu biya kaam kore tai Isor ke dikha nai.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, ki biya kaam ase etu ke hisab nakoribi, kintu ki bhal ase etu he koribi. Jun Isor laga kaam kore, tai Isor laga biya kaam khan kori thaka manu ke dikhi bole para nai.

segments.source: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
segments.reference: Demetrius ke sob manu pora aru hosa pora tai nijor laga gawahi diye. Kintu amikhan bhi gawahi diye, aru tumikhan jane amikhan laga gawahi to hosa ase.
segments.hypothesis: Demetrius laga gawahi sob manu logote ase, aru hosa laga gawahi ase, eneka amikhan bhi sakhi di ase, kintu apnikhan jani ase amikhan laga gawahi hosa ase.

segments.source: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
segments.reference: Moi tumikhan ke bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kolom aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan tumikhan ke likhi bole mon nai.
segments.hypothesis: Moi apuni khan ke bisi kotha likhi bole nimite thakise, kintu moi apuni khan logote bhal aru pen likhi bole mon nai.

segments.source: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
segments.reference: Kintu moi tumikhan ke joldi lok pabole itcha kori ase, titia moi khan ekjon-ekjon logote bohi kene kotha koribo. Tumikhan logote shanti thaki bole dibi. Sathi khan bhi tumikhan ke salam di ase. Naam loi kene ta te thaka sathi khan ke salam di dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu moi asha kore apuni khan ke joldi dikhibo. Etu pichete amikhan nijor laga chehera logote kotha koribo. shanti apuni khan logote shanti thakibi. Aru amikhan ke salam kori ase. Aru apuni khan laga sathi khan ke bhi salam dibi.

segments.source: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
segments.reference: Jude, Jisu Khrista laga ekjon noukar, aru moi James laga bhai, pora likhi ase kunkhan ke mati loise, Baba Isor laga morom kora khan, aru Jisu Khrista nimite rakhise:
segments.hypothesis: Jude, Jisu Khrista laga noukar, James aru bhai James laga bhai, jun khan ke Baba Isor pora pobitro kori dise, aru Jisu Khrista nimite rakhidise.

segments.source: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
segments.reference: Daya aru shanti aru morom apuni khan logote bhorta hoi thaki bole dibo.
segments.hypothesis: Kitia daya, shanti, shanti aru morom bisi hoi kene apnikhan logote thakibi.

segments.source: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
segments.reference: Morom thaka bhai khan, moi khan laga poritran pabole laga kotha apuni khan logote likhi bole kosis korise, aru moi apuni khan ke mon dangor kori dibole nimite etu bhi likhi ase pobitro manu khan nimite ki kaam kori bole dise etu biswas aru mon pora dukh uthaikene hoile bhi kori kene thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Morom bhai khan, moi apnikhan logote ekta bhal poritran likhi bole mon thakise, moi apuni khan ke mon dangor kori bole nimite likhi bole nimite apuni khan laga mon dangor hoise, aru apnikhan ke mon dukh kori bole mon dangor korise.

segments.source: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
segments.reference: Kelemane apuni khan majot pora kunba manu khan lukai kene biya rasta te jaise, kunkhan ke poila pora letera kaam kori dibole nimite pathaise, etu biya manu khan pora mangso laga itcha loi kene Isor laga morom logot bodli kori dise, aru taikhan Jisu Khrista Probhu aru Malik ase koi kene namane.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile ta te kunba manu khan ase jun khan kotha te kotha te likhi kene thakise, taikhan to Isor laga bisar nimite likhi kene thaka manu khan, amikhan laga Isor laga anugrah to chari dise, aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista ke chari kene chari dise.

segments.source: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
segments.reference: Etiya moi apuni khan ke etu kobole nimite itcha kori ase- apuni khan etu sob jani kene thakile bhi- Jisu pora Egypt desh pora manu khan ke bachai loise, kintu pichete kunkhan Taike biswas kora nai taikhan ke khotom kori dise.
segments.hypothesis: Etiya ami apnikhan ke yaad kori bole mon ase, hoilebi apnikhan etu jani ase Probhu, Egypt laga ekta manu khan ke bachai dise, aru jun biswas nakore, taikhan ke biswas kori dise.

segments.source: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
segments.reference: Aru sorgodoth kunkhan nijor laga adhikar diya to bhal pora chola nai, kintu taike diya asol jaga to chari dise- Isor pora taikhan ke kitia bhi khuli bole napara laga loha rusi pora bandhi dise, andhera jagate, jitia tak Isor laga bisar laga din ahi kene napunche.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jun manu taikhan laga prothom kaam nakore, kintu taikhan nijor ghor ke chari kene rakhi kene rakhi thakise, tai laga ghor to kitia bhi dangor din laga bisar laga bisar te rakhi kene thakise.

segments.source: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
segments.reference: Sodom aru Gomorrah aru usorte thaka sheher dusra khan ke kora nisena he, taikhan bhi nijorke bebichari laga kaam te nijorke hali se, aru ki to Isor pora kori bole diya nai etu laga biya itcha kaam khan he korise. Taikhan dusra manu khan nimite ekta sakhi hoise kunkhan norok laga anonto jui te dukh paikene jolibo.
segments.hypothesis: Aru jineka Sodom aru Gomorrah sheher khan taikhan usorte ahise, aru etu nisena, bebichari kaam kori kene, aru ekta dangor kaam nisena jai ase, aru taikhan ke ekta dangor dukh dise, aru jui laga jui laga dukh to khotom khotom khotom kori bole nimite ase.

segments.source: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
segments.reference: Etu nisena he, sapna dikhi thaka manu khan bhi nijor laga gaw letera kori ase. Kintu taikhan Isor laga adhikar ke mana nai, aru taikhan mohima te thaka khan uporte biya kotha khan kori thake.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nisena, taikhan laga bhabona te bhi, manu khan laga bhabona to biya hoi kene, adhikar aru biya kaam khan ke ghin kore.

segments.source: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
segments.reference: Kintu prodhan sorgodoth Michael bhi, jitia tai bhoot logote lorai kori thakise aru Moses laga morija gaw nimite kotha namili kene thakise, tai uporte ekdom biya laga bisar ani diya nai. Kintu tai koise, “Probhu he tumike gali dibi!”
segments.hypothesis: Michael, arche, ekjon manu, bhoot laga kotha loi kene Moses laga gaw laga kotha kotha kotha te kotha kori thakise, tai eku kaam kora nai, kintu apuni ke koise, "Tumi Probhu laga rasta pora hatai dibo lage."

segments.source: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
segments.reference: Kintu etu manu khan pora taikhan bujibo napara khan laga biya kotha koi kene berai thake, aru taikhan nijor laga ki bhabona pora eneka kore, ekta bhal-biya janibo napara janwar nisena, etu pora he taikhan ke khotom kori diye.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu eitu khan sob najane, kintu ki kaam taikhan najane. Taikhan etu kotha khan to bujhi bole para nai, jineka janwar khan bhi najane.

segments.source: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
segments.reference: Hai ase taikhan ke! Kelemane taikhan Cain laga rasta te beraise aru Balaam pora galti kora nisena, kiba labh pabole nimite bisarise. Taikhan Korah pora kotha namani kene thaka logote nijorke harai dise.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan ke hai ase! Kilekoile taikhan Cain laga rasta te jaise, aru Yehudi khan laga gyaan te jhagara kori bole jaise, kintu kaam kori bole nimite. Tai laga biya kaam khan ke morai dise.

segments.source: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
segments.reference: Eitu khan to hoile apuni khan morom laga kha luwa jagate lukai kene thaka ta te ulai thaka jongol nisena ase, aru apuni khan logote sorom nathaki kene eke logote kha luwa kore- taikhan mer rukha manu khan ase kun nijor he khilai. Taikhan pani nathaka badal nisena he ase, aru hawa pora loijai. Taikhan sukha mohina laga ghas te phul ulabole napara nisena he ase- duibar morise, aru jor pora ulaikene phelai dise.
segments.hypothesis: Etu ghas khan apuni laga morom te kha luwa te bohi kene rakhi ase, jitia taikhan apuni khan logote kha luwa koribo, aru jitia taikhan nijorke bhoi nakore, chutu pani nathaka ghas khan ke loi kene, aru ghas khan to mori jaise.

segments.source: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
segments.reference: Taikhan samundar te biya hawa jai thaka nisena ase, taikhan nijor laga sorom to ulaikene dikhai ase. Taikhan eku asha nathakikena berai thaka tara nisena he ase, aru tai nimite dukh laga andhera to hodai nimite rakhidise.
segments.hypothesis: samundar laga hawa, taikhan nijor sorom pora ulai jaise, aru tara khan ke chari kene berai thakise, kelemane etu pora taikhan laga dangor dukh to hodai nimite rakhi kene rakhi kene rakhise.

segments.source: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
segments.reference: Kintu Enoch bhi, jun Adam laga piche aha ekjon ase, taikhan nimite eneka bhabobani korise, aru koise, “Sabi! Probhu Tai laga hajar-hajar pobitro khan pora thaka khan ke loi kene ani ase.
segments.hypothesis: Aru etu kotha to Enoch, aru tai laga sat-ta bhabobadi Adam pora bhabobani korise, "Sabi, Probhu tai laga pobitro hajar hajar laga raja pora ahise.

segments.source: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
segments.reference: Tai sob uporte bisar kori bole nimite ahi ase. Kunkhan Isor pora bhal napa laga sob kisim laga beya kaam kori kene thaki ase, aru kiman paapi manu jun Isor ke bhoi nakori kene tai laga uporte bisi biya kotha koise, eitu khan sob laga uporte bisar kori bole nimite Isor ahi ase.”
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan sob manu ke bisar kori bole aru biya manu khan ke morai dibole nimite, aru taikhan laga kaam to biya kaam kora manu khan nimite kaam kori dise, aru etu to Isor laga biya kaam khan kori bole nimite korise.

segments.source: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
segments.reference: Taikhan dusra logote khushi pora nathaka manu, hodai manu laga biya kotha koi thaka manu, nijor laga biya itcha te berai thaka manu khan ase. Taikhan laga mukh pora phutani laga kotha ulai thake, kun, nijor laga labh nimite dusra manu ke phusla laga kotha kori kene berai thake.
segments.hypothesis: Etu kotha khan laga kotha khan aru kotha khan pora kotha kori thaka khan ase, taikhan laga itcha pichete, taikhan nijor laga mukh pora khandan kori kene kotha kori thake, aru manu khan ke bhal pora bhal pora dikhai dibole nimite.

segments.source: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.reference: Kintu apuni, morom laga bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga apostle khan pora age te ki koi dise eitu khan sob yaad koribi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu, apnikhan laga morom thaka bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga apostle apostle khan age te ki kotha koise etu yaad koribi.

segments.source: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
segments.reference: Taikhan pora apnikhan ke koise, “Duniya khotom hobole thaka homoi te misa kowa manu khan ulabo aru taikhan nijor laga biya itcha pichete he jabo.”
segments.hypothesis: Titia taikhan tumikhan ke koise, "Moi laga poila homoi te, taikhan laga biya kaam kora khan pichete berai jabo."

segments.source: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
segments.reference: Eitu khan nimite he sob bhag hoi kene alag hoijai ase; taikhan duniya laga ase aru taikhan logote Isor laga Atma nai.
segments.hypothesis: Etu khan he ekjon-ekjon-ekjon bhag ase, aru taikhan Atma thaka nohoi.

segments.source: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
segments.reference: Kintu apnikhan, morom laga bhai khan, dangor pobitro biswas pora apnikhan nijorke bonai lobi, aru Pobitro Atma pora prathana koribi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu, morom kora bhai khan, apuni khan laga pobitro biswas te thakibi, Pobitro Atma te prathana koribi.

segments.source: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
segments.reference: Apnikhan nijorke Isor laga morom te rakhibi, aru Jisu Khrista laga anonto jibon aru daya nimite rukhi thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Isor laga morom te thakibi, aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga morom bisari kene anondo jibon nimite.

segments.source: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
segments.reference: Kun manu biswas nakori kene thaki ase tai uporte bhi daya koribi.
segments.hypothesis: Kunba homoi te, bisi morom koribi, aru ekta alag kaam kori bole nimite.

segments.source: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
segments.reference: Kintu dusra manu khan ke jui pora ulaikene bachai lobi. Isor ke bhoi koribi aru dusra khan uporte daya koribi. Aru mangso laga itcha pora letera kora kapra ke ghin koribi.
segments.hypothesis: aru kunba manu khan ke bacha bole aru jui pora jui pora loi loi kene loi jaise, aru kapra kapra ke gaw pora sapha kori kene rakhise.

segments.source: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
segments.reference: Etiya ekjon jun apnikhan ke giribole thaka pora bachai kene rakhe aru Tai laga mohima usorte eku golti aru letera nathaki kene khushi pora khara kori bole diye,
segments.hypothesis: Etiya Isor pora taikhan ke dhori bole pare, aru apnikhan ke Tai laga mohima usorte dukh dibo nimite,

segments.source: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
segments.reference: amikhan laga Isor aru Tran-korta Probhu Jisu Khrista ke, mohima hobole dibi, Tai laga mohanta, aru sob uporte raj kori bole dibi, aru takot, sob homoi te, etiya aru hodai tak thaki bole dibo. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: Isor he amikhan laga Tran-Korta ase, jun ekjon pora nijorke buddhi thaka, mohima, mohima aru takot hobi, etiya bhi aru hodai nimite hobi. Amen.
